properties.name: Feature: Item Charges (No Recharge)
properties.author: Matt Dahse
properties.description: Equipped wands, staves, scrolls and potions get a spell class on the Actions tab. The item itself holds the charges, so a long rest cannot recharge anything. Replaces Advanced Item Actions; do not run both.

announcement.text: Item Charges (No Recharge) v1.2.0: equipped wands, staves, scrolls and potions cast from the Actions tab, and the item keeps the count.
